findings.title: TOCTOU between size admission and AVURLAsset open
findings.message: Media admission uses a path-based stat on an fd that is closed, then AVURLAsset reopens the path by name. This is a TOCTOU window: the file can be swapped for a symlink/FIFO/oversized file after admission, defeating the regular-file and size limit.
findings.suggestion: Document the limitation, or reopen with O_NOFOLLOW and compare dev/ino after asset creation.
findings.evidence: if(!admitted){*error=@"Media must be a regular file of at most 1 GiB.";return nil;}

finding.title: install: can leak observers when called again
finding.message: The KVO observer is added in install: and removed in stop only if the item exists. The poster is added to contentOverlayView only on update, which runs before a player is installed. If an update arrives after install and the poster changes, the new poster is shown even when playback already started (hidden=self.started is used, which is fine). The more significant issue: the removal of the 'status' observer occurs before observeValueForKeyPath dispatches asynchronously, which is safe, but the observer is registered with NSKeyValueObservingOptionInitial and no teardown if install is called twice (a second install would leak the first item's observer and time observer).
finding.suggestion: In install:, tear down any existing item observer and time observer before replacing the player.
